title: Several Versions of the Documentation unavailable: HTTP Error 404
body:
Open the documentation, e.g. https://docs.podman.io/en/v6.0.2/markdown/podman-build.unit.5.html

Change the version to `v5.8.3` and you will a error message from Readthedocs:

```
404 Documentation page not found
The documentation page you requested does not exist or may have been removed.
```

Only the versions starting from `v6.0.0` are available, all other versions are unavailable.

comments.body: well that is just how it works, if new pages are added then they wont exists in older versions of course

@Luap99 Sorry, but I don't understand as there's a menu on the bottom right that let's you change the version number of the to be displayed documentation: So there are two options: 1. That menu should not be displayed as changing the documentation version is not supported. 2. The documentation deployment isn't working correctly

this just just standard readthedocs behavior

The site has all man pages, if new pages are added they can only be shown on a new version. The version selection is always shown and created by readthedocs. I don't see why they or we should bother special casing this.

I guess the only thing we could do is add a custom/better 404 page.
